categories.title: Merchant
categories.info: Most merchants' inventories change on Sundays and Wednesdays.

categories.title: Holotape
categories.info: Holotapes are audio recordings found through the wasteland. They provide lore and details about the world.

categories.title: Skill Book
categories.info: Skill Books permanently raise the corresponding skill by 3 points. The Comprehension perk raises this increase to 4 points.

categories.title: Skill Magazine
categories.info: Skill Magazines are consumable items that raise a skill by 10 points for 60 seconds. The Comprehension perk raises the skill increase to 20, while the Retention perk increases the duration to 3 minutes.

categories.title: Snow Globe
categories.info: Gathered as part of the unmarked quest [Useless Baubles or Fancy Trinkets?](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/mojave-wasteland?locationIds=510014) where each snow globe is worth 2000 caps.

categories.title: Star Bottle Cap
categories.info:
You'll need 50 Star Bottle Caps to complete [The Legend of the Star](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/mojave-wasteland?locationIds=501413), but there are more than 100 to find out in the world.

Drinking Sunset Sarsaparilla also has a random chance to yield a Star Bottle Cap.

categories.title: Armor
categories.info: Armor raises your Damage Threshold, resulting in less damage from attacks. It degrades with use, and must be repaired with similar items (or anything from the same category with the Jury Rigging perk).

locations.title: Doctor Usanagi
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside [New Vegas Medical Clinic](#loc=348656)  
**Services:**
- Treats Health, radiation and addictions.
- Sells a variety of implants:
    - Primary Statistic Implant - +1 to the appropriate statistic, up to +10
    - NEMEAN Subdermal Armor - +4 to Damage Threshold
    - PHOENIX Monocyte Breeder - Grants Health Regeneration (1 Health per 10 seconds)
- Sells Health-related consumables (Chems, X-Pacs, RadAway, Stimpak, etc.)

**Note(s):** Implants are permanent boosts to your statistics. A player may have any number of implants, up to their **base** Endurance.

**Location:** [Mojave Outpost](#loc=355744), Mojave Outpost Barracks - behind a counter in front of the entrance.
  
**Note(s):** 
- Can repair your items.
- Spoken to as part of [My Kind of Town](#loc=355749); pass a Speech 30 check to pardon [Meyers](#loc=486254).
    - Alternatively, pass a 20 Barter check / complete quests at the outpost to have the NCR help Primm.

locations.title: Ranger Jackson
locations.description:
**Location:** [Mojave Outpost](#loc=355744) - On top of one of the barracks buildings.
  
**Note(s):** 
- Speak to him and offer help to begin [Can You Find it in Your Heart?](#loc=486305)

locations.title: Tomas
locations.description:
**Location:** Fighting [Jacklyn](#loc=486311) by the road.
  
**Note(s):**
- Carries [7 Sunset Sarsaparilla Star Bottle Caps.](#loc=486315)
- Hands them over peacefully if you pass a Speech 50 check.

locations.title: Jacklyn
locations.description:
**Location:** Fighting [Tomas](#loc=486310) by the road.
  
**Note(s):**
- Carries [2 Sunset Sarsaparilla Star Bottle Caps](#loc=486314).
- Loots [Tomas](#loc=486310)' body for his 7 Star Bottle Caps if she wins the fight.
- Attacks if you reveal you have Star Bottle Caps on you, or pass an Intelligence 7 check.

locations.title: Oliver Swanick
locations.description:
**Location:** Roaming around the outskirts of [Nipton](#loc=355743).
  
**Note(s):** 
- Carries a Lottery Ticket.

locations.title: Vulpes Inculta
locations.description:
**Location:** [Nipton](#loc=355743) - Outside the town hall.
  
**Note(s):** 
- Gives you the [Cold, Cold Heart](#loc=486320) Quest.
- Can be found in [The Fort](#loc=355895) later in the game.

locations.title: Boxcars
locations.description:
**Location:** [Nipton](#loc=355743), Nipton General Store
  
**Note(s):** 
- Speak to him to begin [Booted](#loc=486343)
- Spoken to as part of [Wheel of Fortune](#loc=486938)
- Spoken to as part of [Keep Your Eyes on the Prize](#loc=486302)
- Can be given Med-X for positive Karma

locations.title: Gabban
locations.description:
**Location:** Nipton - Only appears if [Vulpes Inculta](#loc=486319) was killed on the New Vegas Strip before visiting Nipton for the first time.
  
**Note(s):** Does **not** start the [Cold, Cold Heart](#loc=486320) Quest.

locations.title: Ranger Erasmus
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ranger Station Echo](#loc=410494)  

**Note(s):**
- Adds [Cottonwood Cove](#loc=396377) to your map if you ask what he's doing here.

locations.title: Comm Officer Green
locations.description:
**Location:**   [Ranger Station Echo](#loc=410494)

**Note(s):** 
- Spoken to as part of [Return to Sender](#loc=502606).

locations.title: Ranger Pason
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ranger Station Delta](#loc=484705)

**Note(s):** 
- Spoken to as part of [Return to Sender](#loc=502606)

locations.title: First Sergeant Astor
locations.description:
**Location:** [Camp Searchlight](#loc=396378)  

**Note(s):**
- Ask him about any survivors to begin [We Will All Go Together](#loc=486912)
- Speak to him after discovering [Cottonwood Cove](#loc=396377) to begin [Eye for an Eye](#loc=502612)

locations.title: Logan
locations.description:
**Location:** [Camp Searchlight](#loc=396378), Searchlight NCR Storage - In the basement of the church.  

**Note(s):**
- Begins the [Wheel of Fortune](#loc=486938) quest.
- Carries the [Searchlight Fire Station Key](#loc=486936) and [Searchlight Police Station Key](#loc=486937); neither key can be pickpocketed, and must be taken from his corpse 
- The keys are also given freely during his quest.

locations.title: Private Edwards
locations.description:
**Location:** [Camp Searchlight](#loc=396378), Searchlight Home

**Note(s):**
- Holds an [Irradiated NCR Dogtag](#loc=486935) required for [We Will All Go Together](#loc=486912).
- Can be sent to [Ranger Station Echo](#loc=410494)
- Deciding what to do with him counts as an [unmarked quest](#loc=496464)

locations.title: Alexus
locations.description:
**Location:** [Techatticup Mine](#loc=355722)  

**Note(s):**
- Holds the Techatticup Storage Key

locations.title: Private Reynolds
locations.description:
**Location:** Just up the road from [Techatticup Mine](#loc=355722)  

**Note(s):**
- Agree to help him to begin [Anywhere I Wander](#loc=355721)

locations.title: Dead Sea
locations.description:
**Location:** [Nelson](#loc=410492), Nelson Barracks  

**Note(s):**
- Speak to him and offer to break the stalemate to begin [We Are Legion](#loc=486959)
- Killed as part of [Restoring Hope](#loc=502628)
- Carries the unique weapon [Liberator [Machete]](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/mojave-wasteland?locationIds=486966)

locations.title: Private Stone
locations.description:
**Location:** [Camp Forlorn Hope](#loc=484703)  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Medical Mystery](#loc=486962)

locations.title: Major Polatli
locations.description:
**Location:** [Camp Forlorn Hope](#loc=484703), Camp Forlorn Hope Command Center  

**Note(s):**
- Ask what he needs help with to begin [Restoring Hope](#loc=502628)
- Killed as part of [We Are Legion](#loc=486959)

locations.title: Tech Sergeant Reyes
locations.description:
**Location:** [Camp Forlorn Hope](#loc=484703), Camp Forlorn Hope Command Center  

**Note(s):**
- Speak to her to begin [Return to Sender](#loc=502606)
- Killed as part of [We Are Legion](#loc=486959)

locations.title: The Lonesome Drifter
locations.description:
**Location:** Sitting near a Sunset Sarsaparilla billboard.  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Talent Pool](#loc=502639)
- Holds the [Mysterious Magnum](#loc=355739)
- Wears the [Regulator Duster](#loc=489337)

locations.title: The Forecaster
locations.description:
**Location:** [188 Trading Post](#loc=355730), sitting on the lower road.  

**Note(s):**
- Can be paid 100 caps to [hear some thoughts.](#loc=496445)

locations.title: Ezekiel
locations.description:
**Location:** [188 Trading Post](#loc=355730), by the road leading north.  

**Note(s):**
- Carries [Pretty Pretty Horsies: A History of the Mongol Empire](#loc=513478)

locations.title: Comm Officer Castillo
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ranger Station Alpha](#loc=355567)  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Return to Sender](#loc=502606).

locations.title: Ranger Lineholm
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ranger Station Alpha](#loc=355567)  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Return to Sender](#loc=502606)

locations.title: Comm Officer Tilden
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ranger Station Bravo](#loc=357371)  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Return to Sender](#loc=502606)
- Adds [Camp Guardian](#loc=357325) to your map.

locations.title: Ranger Ericsen
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ranger Station Bravo](#loc=357371)  

**Note(s):**
- In charge of the station

locations.title: Decanus Severus
locations.description:
**Location:** [Cottonwood Cove](#loc=396377)  

**Note(s):**
- Can be taught to disarm NCR mines for Legion fame after an Explosives 50 check.
- Trades supplies for NCR dog tags if a Barter 35 check was passed with [Aurelius of Phoenix](#loc=489411) as part of [Arizona Scavenger](#loc=489414).

locations.title: Aurelius of Phoenix
locations.description:
**Location:** [Cottonwood Cove](#loc=396377)  

**Note(s):**
- In [Eye for an Eye](#loc=502612), gives you the [Old Legion Paperwork / Patrol Notes / Raid Plans](#loc=502614) for the [NCR Bug](#loc=502613)
- Speak to him to begin [Arizona Scavenger](#loc=489414)

locations.title: Diane
locations.description:
**Location:** [Red Rock Drug Lab](#loc=484724)  

**Note(s):**
- Ask her for work to begin [Aba Daba Honeymoon](#loc=355728)

locations.title: Anders
locations.description:
**Location:** On a cross beside the road leading to [Cottonwood Cove](#loc=396377)  

**Note(s):**
- Rescued as part of [Aba Daba Honeymoon](#loc=355728)

locations.title: Doctor Alvarez
locations.description:
**Location:** [Follower's Outpost](#loc=355570)  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [I Could Make You Care](#loc=502651)

locations.title: Cannibal Johnson
locations.description:
**Location:** [Cannibal Johnson's Cave](#loc=355563)  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [For Auld Lang Syne](#loc=502616)

locations.title: Alice McLafferty
locations.description:
**Location:** [Crimson Caravan Company](#loc=355529), Crimson Caravan Main Office  

**Note(s):**
- Ask her for work to begin [You Can Depend On Me](#loc=489798)
- Spoken to as part of [Heartache by the Number](#loc=355889)
- Spoken to as part of [Young Hearts](#loc=485403)

locations.title: Don Hostetler
locations.description:
**Location:** [Crimson Caravan Company](#loc=355529), Crimson Caravan Main Office - but only during the day.

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Aba Daba Honeymoon](#loc=355728)

locations.title: Janet
locations.description:
**Location:** [Crimson Caravan Company](#loc=355529)  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Young Hearts](#loc=485403)
  - Moves to [Nellis Air Force Base](#loc=396375) as part of the quest

locations.title: Legate Lanius
locations.description:
**Location:** [Legate's Camp](#loc=484706)   

**Note(s):**
- Carries the [Blade of the East [Bumper Sword]](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/mojave-wasteland?locationIds=490235)
- Wears the unique [Legate Helmet](#loc=490237) and [Legate Armor](#loc=490238)

locations.title: Red Lucy
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Thorn](#loc=484717)  

**Note(s):**
- Flirt with her and offer tribute to begin [Bleed Me Dry](#loc=491182)
- Adds [Vault 22](#loc=355888) to your map
- Can be romanced
- Speak to her to place bets on the next fight, or enter the ring yourself.
  - Opponents you can choose to fight yourself include Giant Mantises, Radscorpions and Giant Radscorpions
  - Custom fights between two different creatures can be arranged - options include Giant Mantises, Radscorpions, Giant Radscorpions, Fire Geckos, Nightstalkers, Cazadores, Fiends and Deathclaws.

locations.title: Caesar
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Fort](#loc=355895), Caesar's Tent 

**Note(s):**
- Leader of Caesar's Legion
- Wears [Caesar's Armor](#loc=491241)
- Speak to him to begin [Render Unto Caesar](#loc=491237)

locations.title: Snuffles
locations.description:
**Location:** [Sloan](#loc=355355)  

**Note(s):**
- Its injured leg can be healed with a Medicine 30 check.

locations.title: Chomps Lewis
locations.description:
**Location:** Standing in the road near [Sloan](#loc=355355).  

**Note(s):**
- Adds [Quarry Junction](#loc=354626) to your map.
- Tell him you fixed [Snuffles](#loc=500366)' leg to complete [Claws Mended](#loc=500367)
- Tell him you fixed the nearby generator to complete [Power to the People](#loc=500374) 
- Spoken to as part of [Don't Make a Beggar of Me](#loc=484621)
- Offer help with the Deathclaw problem to begin [Claws Out](#loc=500372)
  - Offering help at level 15 or greater yields 5 Stimpaks and 5 Super Stimpaks.

locations.title: Neil
locations.description:
**Location:** [Neil's Shack](#loc=484710)  

**Note(s):**
- Speaking to him begins [Crazy, Crazy, Crazy](#loc=484711)
- Pass a Speech 50 check in your first meeting to have him lure away the Nightkin near the broadcast tower

locations.title: Philip Lem
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 19](#loc=355578) - Inside an Overseer's Office to your left soon after entering.  

**Note(s):**
- Agree to help him destroy the sulphur deposits to begin [Why Can't We Be Friends?](#loc=501390)
  - Doing so will see him give you the [Blue Sector Keycard](#loc=501391)
- Wears the unique Tortiseshell Glasses, but only in older versions of the game.

locations.title: Samuel Cooke
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 19](#loc=355578) - Inside an Overseer's Office to your right soon after entering.  

**Note(s):**
- Agree to kill the fire geckos to begin [Why Can't We Be Friends?](#loc=501390)
  - Doing so will see him give you the Red Sector Keycard

locations.title: Festus
locations.description:
**Location:** [Sunset Sarsaparilla Headquarters](#loc=355765) - On your left after walking in through the main entrance.  

**Note(s):**
- Speak to him about star bottle caps to begin [The Legend of the Star](#loc=501413).
- Speak to him again after finding 50 Star Bottle Caps to begin [A Valuable Lesson](#loc=501414)

locations.title: Marcus
locations.description:
**Location:** [Jacobstown](#loc=484626) - Standing by the gate when you first approach  

**Note(s):**
- Returning character from Fallout 2
- Gives you the [Unfriendly Persuasion](#loc=484632) quest when you try to leave the town

locations.title: Keene
locations.description:
**Location:** [Jacobstown](#loc=484626), Jacobstown Lodge  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Guess Who I Saw Today](#loc=348693); you'll need to pass a Speech 80 check to avoid a fight.

locations.title: Doctor Henry
locations.description:
**Location:** [Jacobstown](#loc=484626), Jacobstown Lodge - In the large room to your right as you enter.  

**Note(s):**
- Offer to help with his research to begin [Guess Who I Saw Today](#loc=348693)
- Adds [Charleston Cave](#loc=348691) to your map
- Spoken to as part of [For Auld Lang Syne](#loc=502616)
- Spoken to as part of [Nothin' But a Hound Dog](#loc=502621)
- Returning character from Fallout 2

locations.title: Norton
locations.description:
**Location:** Standing on the road leading to Jacobstown, but only after beginning [Unfriendly Persuasion](#loc=484632)  

**Note(s):**
- Can be sent away peacefully with a Speech 65 check
- Can be bribed with 2500 caps
- Holds a [Star Bottle Cap](#loc=501654) and [Mercenary Note](#loc=501655)

locations.title: George
locations.description:
**Location:** Standing on the road near [Field's Shack](#loc=396376)  

**Note(s):**
- Offers a 300 (200 after a Barter 40 check) cap wager - accept it to begin [Highway to the Danger Zone](#loc=501665) and receive the [Nellis Artillery Timing Details](#loc=501664)
- After reaching [Nellis Air Force Base](#loc=396375), return to collect the caps (and pass a Speech 60 check for another hundred)

locations.title: Pearl
locations.description:
**Location:** [Nellis Air Force Base](#loc=396375), Pearl's Barracks  

**Note(s):**
- Leader of the Boomers
- Gives you the [Volare!](#loc=485121) quest
- Spoken to as part of [Things That Go Boom](#loc=501713)
- Spoken to as part of [Render Unto Caesar](#loc=491237)
- Spoken to as part of [The House Always Wins III](#loc=502644)
- Spoken to as part of  [Wild Card: Side Bets](#loc=357316)
- Spoken to as part of [Young Hearts](#loc=485403)
- Spoken to as part of [I Hear You Knocking](#loc=502585)

locations.title: Raquel
locations.description:
**Location:** [Nellis Air Force Base](#loc=396375) - Often found on top of the shipping containers in the area.

**Note(s):**
- Gives you the [Ant Misbehavin'](#loc=355723) quest and [Nellis Generator Key](#loc=485127) when you offer to help with her bug problem
- Gives you the unmarked quest [Missing a Few Missiles](#loc=501707) after completing her previous quest
  - Bring her missiles to increase Boomers fame

locations.title: Pete
locations.description:
**Location:** [Nellis Air Force Base](#loc=396375), Nellis Boomer Museum  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Volare!](#loc=485121)
- After watching his museum tour, speak to him for some skill checks that yield Boomers fame.
  - Checks include Explosives 40, Science 35, Survival 40, Speech 40, Speech 55, and Repair 40.

locations.title: Loyal
locations.description:
**Location:** [Nellis Air Force Base](#loc=396375), Loyal's House

**Note(s):**
- Speak to him to begin [Sunshine Boogie](#loc=501683)
- Can also be found in the [Nellis Hangars](#loc=484638) during the daytime
- Adds the [Crashed B-29](#loc=354664) to your map after progressing in [Volare!](#loc=485121)

locations.title: Jack
locations.description:
**Location:** [Nellis Hangars](#loc=484638)  

**Note(s):**
- Gives you the [Rebreather](#loc=501709) after passing a Science 45 check or providing him with a pressure cooker during [Volare!](#loc=485121)
- Begins the unmarked quest [Iron and Stealing](#loc=501700)
  - Bring him Scrap Metal to receive Boomers fame
- Pass a Speech 35 check to begin [Young Hearts](#loc=485403)
  - The Black Widow / Confirmed Bachelor perk can also be used to start the quest

locations.title: Lindsay
locations.description:
**Location:** [Nellis Air Force Base](#loc=396375) - Either found wandering around, in the schoolhouse, or in the children's barracks.  

**Note(s):**
- Offer to find Mr. Cuddles to begin the unmarked quest [Bear Necessities](#loc=485129)

locations.title: Ranger Andy
locations.description:
**Location:** [Novac](#loc=355741), Ranger Andy's Bungalow  

**Note(s):**
- Ask if he's part of the NCR to begin [Andy and Charlie](#loc=495278)
- Adds [Ranger Station Charlie](#loc=354665) to your map
- Spoken to as part of [One for My Baby](#loc=501905)
- Spoken to as part of Old School Ghoul

locations.title: Jeannie May Crawford
locations.description:
**Location:** [Novac](#loc=355741), Dino Dee-lite Front Desk  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [One for My Baby](#loc=501905)
- Adds [REPCONN Test Site](#loc=356058), [HELIOS One](#loc=484709), and [Nelson](#loc=410492) to your map
- Holds [Jeannie May's Safe Key](#loc=501910)
- Offers a [room at the motel](#loc=501938) for 100 Caps, or gives it freely if your Novac reputation is Accepted or higher.

locations.title: Manny Vargas
locations.description:
**Location:** [Novac](#loc=355741) - Standing inside the mouth of the dinosaur statue during the daytime.  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [They Went That-a-Way](#loc=355731)
- Carries the [Message: Khan Hospitality](#loc=501913) note
  - It can be obtained through dialogue if you use the Confirmed Bachelor perk
- Adds the [REPCONN Test Site](#loc=356058) to your map
- One of a few NPCs that can start the [Come Fly With Me](#loc=485415) quest.

locations.title: Bruce Isaac
locations.description:
**Location:** [Novac](#loc=355741), inside a motel room on the upper floor.  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Talent Pool](#loc=502639)

locations.title: Daisy Whitman
locations.description:
**Location:** [Novac](#loc=355741)  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [For Auld Lang Syne](#loc=502616)
- Trains you to wear Power Armor after completing the quest
- The crashed vertibird she mentions can be found [here](#loc=354646)

locations.title: Dusty McBride
locations.description:
**Location:** [Novac](#loc=355741), McBride House  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [One for My Baby](#loc=501905)
- Ask about the Brahmin attacks to begin [The Screams of Brahmin](#loc=501918)

locations.title: Alice McBride
locations.description:
**Location:** [Novac](#loc=355741), McBride House  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [One for My Baby](#loc=501905)
- Spoken to as part of [The Screams of Brahmin](#loc=501918)

locations.title: Victor
locations.description:
**Location:** [Novac](#loc=355741), standing near the gate.  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [We Must Stop Meeting Like This](#loc=501923)
- Only appears here if you have **not** entered the Lucky 38 for the first time.

locations.title: Victor
locations.description:
**Location:** [Goodsprings](#loc=355160) - Patrolling the roads or in his shack at the southern end of town.

**Note(s):**
- Optionally spoken to as part of [They Went That-a-Way](#loc=355731)
  - Adds the [Goodsprings Cemetery](#loc=357323) to your map if you haven't been there already
- Begins the unmarked quest [We Must Stop Meeting Like This](#loc=501923)
- Spoken to as part of another unmarked quest, [We Must Stop Beating Like This](#loc=501924)

locations.title: Layla
locations.description:
**Location:** [Primm](#loc=355752), Vikki & Vance Casino 3 days after completing [My Kind of Town](#loc=355749)  

**Note(s):**
- Begins the unmarked quest [A Team of Moronic Mercenaries](#loc=501927)
- Can be paid to leave with a 50 or 100 cap bribe
- Can be convinced to leave after a Speech 30 check

locations.title: Tour Guide
locations.description:
**Location:** [REPCONN Headquarters](#loc=355571)  

**Note(s):**
- Guides you through the ground floor's exhibits as part of [Honorary Rocketeer](#loc=501946), but only between 10AM and 5PM.
  - This tour unlocks multiple doors, making it easier to access [Jenny Millet's Security Keycard](#loc=485067)
- Carries the [REPCONN Planetarium Key](#loc=501948)

locations.title: Chris Haversam
locations.description:
**Location:** [REPCONN Test Site](#loc=356058), REPCONN Research Labs

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Come Fly With Me](#loc=485415)
- Relocates to [Novac](#loc=355741) after the quest.
- Can be convinced he's not a ghoul by speaking to [Jason Bright](#loc=501951) and passing a Speech 50 check

locations.title: Jason Bright
locations.description:
**Location:** [REPCONN Test Site](#loc=356058), REPCONN Research Labs

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Come Fly With Me](#loc=485415)
- Gives you the [REPCONN Basement Key](#loc=501952)
- Speak to him with [Veronica](#loc=486438) as a companion to progress [I Could Make You Care](#loc=502651)

locations.title: Davison
locations.description:
**Location:** [REPCONN Test Site](#loc=356058), Basement  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Come Fly With Me](#loc=485415)
- Turns hostile if you touch the Brahmin skull
- Turns hostile if you kill too many Nightkin in the basement
- Gives you [Davison's Key](#loc=501954) if you offer to help him find the Stealth Boys
- Leaves peacefully if you find the [Stealthboy Shipment Update](#loc=501957)

locations.title: Harland
locations.description:
**Location:** [REPCONN Test Site](#loc=356058), REPCONN Basement - In the room unlocked with [Davison's Key](#loc=501954)

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Come Fly With Me](#loc=485415)
- Holds Harland's Key, which has no use.
- Will only co-operate after you use the [Jail Key](#loc=501956) to discover what happened to a ghoul prisoner in the sub-basement.

locations.title: Lieutenant Monroe
locations.description:
**Location:** [Boulder City](#loc=355737) - Standing outside the entrance to the Boulder City Ruins.  

**Note(s):**
- Speaking to him begins [Boulder City Showdown](#loc=355736)
- Moves to [Camp Forlorn Hope](#loc=484703) if he survives the showdown

locations.title: Jessup
locations.description:
**Location:** [Boulder City](#loc=355737), Great Khan Hideout  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [Boulder City Showdown](#loc=355736) and [They Went That-a-Way](#loc=355731)
  - Pass a Speech 45 check to have the hostages freed peacefully. 
  - He'll give you the [Engraved Cigarette Lighter](#loc=501965) for this.
- Wears [Jessup's Bandana](#loc=501966)
- Carries the [Chairmen Job Offer](#loc=501964); it must be pickpocketed or taken from his corpse.
- Moves to [Red Rock Canyon](#loc=396374) if he survives the showdown.

locations.title: Victor
locations.description:
**Location:** [Boulder City](#loc=355737) - Standing on the wooden platform outside the train station.  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [We Must Stop Meeting Like This](#loc=501923)
- Only appears here if you have **not** entered the Lucky 38 for the first time.

locations.title: Private Kowalski
locations.description:
**Location:** [Boulder City](#loc=355737), near the [First Battle of Hoover Dam Memorial](#loc=355738)  

**Note(s):**
- Does not stay at Boulder City forever
- Shooting, hitting, or photographing the memorial in front of him begins [Defacing the Humble Stone](#loc=501949)
- Ragebaiting and killing him when he attacks does not yield any NCR infamy or turn nearby rangers hostile

locations.title: Fantastic
locations.description:
**Location:** [HELIOS One](#loc=484709), north-eastern edge of the local map.

**Note(s):**
- **_Has a theoretical degree in physics! Wow!_**
- Tell him that you're here to replace him, then pass a Speech 25 check to receive 100 caps.
- Speak to him to begin [That Lucky Old Sun](#loc=502527)

locations.title: Lt. Haggerty
locations.description:
**Location:**   [HELIOS One](#loc=484709), standing outside the entrance.

**Note(s):**
- Speak to her to begin [That Lucky Old Sun](#loc=502527)

locations.title: Ignacio Rivas
locations.description:
**Location:**  [HELIOS One](#loc=484709), north-eastern edge of the local map.

**Note(s):**
- Gives you a [Big Book of Science](#loc=487967) if you distribute power to the whole grid during [That Lucky Old Sun](#loc=502527)

locations.title: Captain Gilles
locations.description:

**Note(s):**

locations.title: Elijah's Holomessage
locations.description:
**Location:** [Abandoned BoS Bunker](#loc=351613) - Only appears after you complete the Dead Money DLC; on a terminal in the unlocked room.

Show it to [Veronica](#loc=486438) and she'll unlock the 'Elijah's Last Words' perk, increasing her attack speed by 150% and giving her a 25% chance to knock down enemies.

Alternatively, you can get her to unlock it then keep it to yourself to unlock the 'Elijah's Ramblings' perk, making your Critical Hits with Melee Weapons do 150% more damage.

locations.title: Ranger Holodisk Message
locations.description:
**Location:** On the upper floor of a destroyed house surrounded by skeletons.

Cannot be picked up.

Must be pickpocketed, or taken from his corpse, or taken from his inventory after you rescue him (by telling him to "take a weapon".)

- 1687865 - On a table next to the terminal
- 6585645 - On the floor beneath the terminal.
- 1648654 - On the floor beneath a chair behind the terminal.
- 3905698 - On the floor beneath some shelves, near a gurney.
- 5498465 - In the corner of the room, next to the gurney.

Must be pickpocketed or taken from his corpse.

Obtaining it completes the [Democracy Inaction](#loc=509886) unmarked quest.

There, a locked (Very Easy) terminal that can be unlocked with [Roy Gottlieb's Terminal Password](#loc=509897) holds the holotape.

locations.title: Wanted: Deathclaw Egg

locations.title: Matter Modulator Project
locations.description: **Location:** [REPCONN Headquarters](#loc=355571), REPCONN Office 2nd Floor - Obtained when reading the 'Q-35 Release Notes' entry on a locked (Easy) terminal, found behind a locked (Average) door.

**Used to Unlock:** The door near the entrance (surrounded by Fiend corpses).

locations.title: REPCONN Second Floor Security Card
locations.description: **Location:** [REPCONN Headquarters](#loc=355571), REPCONN Office 2nd Floor - Next to a terminal in a small room.

locations.title: REPCONN Third Floor Security Card

**Location:** [REPCONN Headquarters](#loc=355571), REPCONN Office Top Floor - Inside Piers Isley's briefcase, found on the ground near a pile of rubble.

Can also be obtained by hacking into a Hard terminal on the second floor, near the [REPCONN Second Floor Security Card](#loc=485083).

**Used to Unlock:** Doors to the [Q-35 Matter Modulator](#loc=357382) room.

locations.title: Nellis Generator Key

**Location:** [Nellis Air Force Base](#loc=396375) - Speak to Raquel and begin [Ant Misbehavin'](#loc=355723).

**Used to Unlock:** [Nellis Array](#loc=484636)

locations.title: Key

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) locker at the back of the shack.

**Used to Unlock:** Maintenance Door on the same floor.

locations.title: Worn Key

**Used to Unlock:** Gun Cabinet near a fallen bookshelf on the third floor.

**Used to Unlock:** Nearby door leading down to the basement.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Very Hard) gate near the entrance. Watch out for the tripwire right behind it!

**Used to Unlock:** Gate at the end of the left tunnel.

**Used to Unlock:** Gates throughout the mine.

locations.title: Key

**Used to Unlock:** The door to the cellar!

locations.title: Key
locations.description:

**Used to Unlock:** Gun cabinet

**Used to Unlock:** The container holding the pulse gun in the [Vault 34](#loc=355561) armory.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Hard) Explosives Crate just across the planks.

Can also be found by pickpocketing / looting Escaped Convicts throughout the vault.

Can also be found by pickpocketing / looting Escaped Convicts throughout the vault.

**Used to Unlock:** Red Sector doors in Vault 19

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) metal box in the corner of the garage.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Very Easy) door behind the counter in the Dino Bite Gift Shop, where [That Gun [5.56mm Pistol]](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/mojave-wasteland?locationIds=410477) can be found.

locations.description:
**Location:** [Novac](#loc=355741)

Purchased from [Jeannie May Crawford](#loc=501909) for 100 caps by asking to rent a room, or given freely if your Novac reputation is Accepted or higher. 

May also be given by [Cliff Briscoe](#loc=489535) by speaking to him if Jeannie is killed. 

**Used to Unlock:** Motel room on the upper floor.

locations.title: REPCONN Planetarium Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [REPCONN Headquarters](#loc=355571) - In the inventory of the [Tour Guide](#loc=501947). Must be taken from its corpse.

**Used to Unlock:** The planetarium on the ground floor. It will be unlocked for you as part of [Honorary Rocketeer](#loc=501946) if you take a tour.

locations.title: REPCONN Basement Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [REPCONN Test Site](#loc=356058), REPCONN Research Labs - Given to you by [Jason Bright](#loc=501951) when you agree to help him with the demons.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Easy) door to the basement

locations.title: Davison's Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [REPCONN Test Site](#loc=356058), REPCONN Basement - Given to you by [Davison](#loc=501953) if you offer to help find the Stealth Boys.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Easy) door at the end of a nearby corridor.

locations.title: Jail Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [REPCONN Test Site](#loc=356058), REPCONN Basement - In the inventory of a Nightkin Jailer, or inside a desk at the edge of a side-room above the cells.

**Used to Unlock:** A door that cannot be lockpicked in the sub-basement (the area with chain-link ceilings)

locations.title: Vault 11 Overseer's Terminal Password
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 11](#loc=355579), Vault 11 Lower Level - Unlocked when reading the [Prepared Speech of Gus Olson, Ombudsman, for the Annual Overseer Election](#loc=509888) via holotape or the terminal on the upper level of the atrium.

**Used to Unlock:** Terminal in the Overseer's office

locations.title: Roy Gottlieb's Terminal Password
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 11](#loc=355579), Vault 11 Living Quarters - Follow the 'Male Dorm' sign into a corridor, then enter the second room on your left to find it in a footlocker under the fallen shelves.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Very Easy) terminal in the same room.

locations.title: Saint James' Room Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Casa Madrid Apartments](#loc=512757) - In the inventory of [Sweetie](#loc=512771). Can be obtained through pickpocketing, or after beginning [The Coyotes](#loc=502631), any of the following:
- Exchanged for 250 caps
- By Using the Lady Killer / Cherchez la Femme perks in dialogue
- By talking to her after killing Saint James.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) door to Saint James' apartment downstairs.

locations.title: Lucky 38 VIP Keycard
locations.description:
**Location:** [Camp Golf](#loc=410495), House Resort - On top of a desk on the ground floor. From the main entrance, go straight forward and into the office on the left.

**Used to Unlock:** Terminal in the Lucky 38 Penthouse

locations.title: Vault 34 Security Terminal Password
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 34](#loc=355561), 1st floor - As you enter the vault proper, jump down one level and take stairs down another level. Follow the corridor, taking the first path to the right, then swim into a flooded section to find it on the Vault Technician's corpse.

[Rebreather](#loc=501709) recommended.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Very Hard) terminal in [Security Station A](#loc=512817), used to unlock the Overseer's Quarter.

locations.title: Vault 34 Utility Terminal Password
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 34](#loc=355561), 1st floor - In the inventory of a Vault Technician found in a flooded section reached through a corridor beside the clinic.

[Rebreather](#loc=501709) recommended. 

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Very Hard) terminal in a nearby room marked 'Utility'.

locations.title: Overseer's Password
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 34](#loc=355561), Overseer's Quarter / Reactor - In the inventory of the Overseer, found inside their office.

_To get into the Overseer's Quarter, you'll need the [Vault 34 Security Terminal Password](#loc=512810) or Science 100 to hack the terminal._

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Very Hard) terminal at the back of the office, used to lift lockdown in the armory and access the [All-American [Marksman Carbine]](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/mojave-wasteland?locationIds=485414).

locations.title: Pacer's Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [King's School of Impersonation](#loc=509980) - In the inventory of [Pacer](#loc=512828).

**Used to Unlock:** Door he can be found leaning next to in the main lobby

locations.title: Zoara Club Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Gomorrah](#loc=509971) - In the inventories of Omerta Thugs standing near locked (Average) doors on the main level and Lower Brimstone.

Also found in the inventory of [Clanden](#loc=512837), and given to you by [Cachino](#loc=514902) during [How Little We Know](#loc=502636)

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) doors throughout The Gomorrah.

locations.title: Clanden's Room Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Gomorrah](#loc=509971), Gomorrah Suites - Carried by [Clanden](#loc=512837).

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Hard) safe behind the dresser, containing [Snuff Tapes](#loc=513467).

locations.title: NCR Embassy Cell Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [NCR Military Police HQ](#loc=509975) - Inside the locked (Average) desk on the right side of the main room.

**Used to Unlock:** Cells in the other room.

locations.title: Benny's Suite Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Tops](#loc=509970) - Given to you by [Swank](#loc=513271) after passing Speech 15, 30, and 45 checks. 

Can also be pickpocketed from [Benny](#loc=513285), taken from his corpse, or obtained by seducing him if you're playing as a female courier with the Black Widow perk.

**Used to Unlock:** Benny's suite on the 13th floor.

locations.title: High Roller Suite Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Tops](#loc=509970), after winning ~7,500 chips from the various games.

**Used to Unlock:** High Roller suite on the 13th floor.

locations.title: The Tops Presidential Suite Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Tops](#loc=509970) - Given to you by [Benny](#loc=513285), or taken from his corpse.

**Used to Unlock:** Elevator to the Presidential Suite.

locations.title: Forlorn Hope Storage Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Camp Forlorn Hope](#loc=484703) - Carried by [Quartermaster Mayes](#loc=486963)

**Used to Unlock:** [Camp Forlorn Hope Storage Shed](#loc=513297)

locations.title: Western Reflector Control Terminal Password
locations.description:
**Location:** [HELIOS One](#loc=484709) - Given to you by [Fantastic](#loc=502510) after agreeing to help him as part of [That Lucky Old Sun](#loc=502527)

**Used to Unlock:** Terminal 1, surrounded by boobytraps in the area behind [HELIOS One](#loc=484709)

locations.title: Eastern Reflector Control Terminal Password
locations.description:
**Location:** [HELIOS One](#loc=484709) - Given to you by [Ignacio Rivas](#loc=502552) after agreeing to help him as part of [That Lucky Old Sun](#loc=502527)

Can also be pickpocketed, taken from his corpse, or found on a table in his bedroom on the upper floor.

**Used to Unlock:** Terminal 2 in the area behind [HELIOS One](#loc=484709)

locations.title: NCRCF Visitor's Center Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [NCR Correctional Facility](#loc=351692) - Carried by [Dawes](#loc=513358).

**Used to Unlock:** Visitor's Center

locations.title: Cell Block B Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [NCR Correctional Facility](#loc=351692) - In the inventory of [Carter](#loc=513363).

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Easy) cell door in Cell Block B.

locations.title: Administration Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [NCR Correctional Facility](#loc=351692), Administration Building - Carried by [Eddie](#loc=351695).

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) door to a room full of ammo on the upper floor

locations.title: Hoover Dam Saferoom Key (x4)
locations.description:
**Location:** [Hoover Dam](#loc=396394), Offices - Three can be found inside desks in a large room. One can be found inside the desk in [Colonel Cassandra Moore](#loc=513378)'s office. All must be stolen.

**Used to Unlock:** Saferoom on the upper floor of the Visitor Center.

locations.title: Fiend Prisoner Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 3](#loc=348699), Living Quarters - In the inventory of Daniel, a named Fiend in a bedroom at the south-eastern end of the map. Can be pickpocketed or looted from his corpse.

**Used to Unlock:** Cell holding [Rick Lancer](#loc=513403) prisoner.

locations.title: Vault 3 Maintenance Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 3](#loc=348699), Living Quarters - In the inventory of Daniel, a named Fiend in a bedroom at the south-eastern end of the map. Can be pickpocketed or looted from his corpse.

One is also held by [Bryce Anders](#loc=513407).

**Used to Unlock:** Door to the Vault 3 Maintenance Wing area.

locations.title: Vault 3 Overseer Password
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 3](#loc=348699), Living Quarters - Given to you by [Rick Lancer](#loc=513403), either through intimidation or [unlocking his cell.](#loc=513404)

**Used to Unlock:** Hard-to-hack terminal in the Overseer's office, which unlocks Hard-to-pick doors in the flooded section - but this is notoriously buggy, and they may not actually be unlocked.

locations.title: NCR Safehouse Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Camp McCarran Terminal Building](#loc=512639) - Given to you after reaching a Liked reputation with the NCR as part of [Rest and Resupply](#loc=510047).

**Used to Unlock:** [NCR Ranger Safehouse](#loc=351596)

locations.title: Crimson Caravan Safe Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Crimson Caravan Main Office](#loc=512671) - In the inventory of [Alice McLafferty](#loc=489797).

**Used to Unlock:** The locked (Average) safe next to her desk.

locations.title: To: *@%!@#--!
locations.description:
**Location:** [REPCONN Headquarters](#loc=355571), REPCONN Office 2nd Floor - Obtained when reading the 'Encrypted Message' entry on a locked (Easy) terminal, found behind a locked (Average) door.

_Note: When added to your Pip-Boy, this note doesn't have a name, and appears as a blank space._

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Easy) terminal on the top floor.

locations.title: Keely's Password
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 22](#loc=355888) - In the inventory of Keely. 

**Used to Unlock:** Terminal that controls the main vault door; only necessary near the end of [There Stands the Grass](#loc=502627) if Keely was rescued.

locations.title: Great Khans Supply Cache Key
locations.description:
**Location:** Held by [Oscar Velasco](#loc=513485); he'll give it to you after passing a Speech 50 check or it can be taken from his corpse.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Easy) gates in the caves around Bitter Springs.

locations.title: Hidden Valley Self-Destruct Password
locations.description:
**Location:** [Hidden Valley](#loc=484728), Bunker - Obtained when viewing the 'Generate Self-Destruct Password' entry on a terminal in the room with the VR pods. This is only possible if you're holding the [Head Paladin's Keycard](#loc=513489), [Elder's Keycard](#loc=513491), and [Head Scribe's Keycard](#loc=513490).

**Used to Unlock:** Self destruct sequence on the self-destruct terminal.

locations.title: Vault 22 Cave Door Keycard
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 22](#loc=355888), Common Areas - On a shelf in a bedroom on the lower level. To reach it, you'll need to pick through a locked (Average) door or unlock it via terminal in the Overseer's office.

**Used to Unlock:** Door to the cave system on the Food Production floor.

locations.title: Lucky 38 VIP Keycard
locations.description:
**Location:** [H&H Tools Factory](#loc=356054) - On top of the desk in Anthony House's office.

**Used to Unlock:** Terminal in the Lucky 38 Penthouse

locations.title: Terminal Access Card
locations.description:
**Location:** [Cerulean Robotics](#loc=351669) - Inside a locked (Average) tool cabinet, unlocked via [Cerulean Robotics Key](#loc=514896)

**Related Quest:** [Wang Dang Atomic Tango](#loc=502641)

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) Protectron Programming Interface terminal next to the protectron pod in the corner.

locations.title: Atomic Wrangler Bank Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Atomic Wrangler](#loc=509982) - Carried by [James Garret](#loc=513695) and [Francine Garret](#loc=513701)

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Very Hard) door to the [Atomic Wrangler Cashier](#loc=513698)'s area.

locations.title: Atomic Wrangler Upstairs Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Atomic Wrangler](#loc=509982) - In the inventory of [James Garret](#loc=513695) and [Francine Garret](#loc=513701)

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) door to the top floor, locked (Very Hard) door to the kitchen on the ground floor, and locked (Very Hard) safe under the bed in the first room on the top floor.

locations.title: Followers Safehouse Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Old Mormon Fort](#loc=354654) - Given to you after reaching an Idolized reputation with the Followers of the Apocalypse and agreeing to join them as part of [Friend of the Followers](#loc=510035).

**Used to Unlock:** [Followers Safehouse](#loc=354653)

locations.title: Caesar's Legion Safehouse Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Fort](#loc=513499) - Given to you by [Lucius](#loc=351600) after reaching a reputation of Liked or better with Caesar's Legion.

**Used to Unlock:** [Caesar's Legion Safehouse](#loc=351599)

locations.title: Sarah's Dresser Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 21 Gift Shop](#loc=509976) - In the inventory of [Sarah](#loc=513262).

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) dresser inside Sarah's room, found deeper in the vault.

locations.title: Sarah's Room Passcard
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 21 Gift Shop](#loc=509976) - In the inventory of [Sarah](#loc=513262).

**Used to Unlock:** Sarah's Locked (Average) room, found deeper in the vault.

locations.title: Hidden Valley Bunker Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Hidden Valley Bunker](#loc=514343) - Carried by [Paladin Ramos](#loc=514348).

Can also be found in the inventories of Brotherhood of Steel Paladins.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Very Hard) door to the Hidden Valley Bunker.

locations.title: Hidden Valley Depot Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Hidden Valley Bunker](#loc=514343), L1 - In the inventory of [Knight Torres](#loc=514355).

**Used to Unlock:** Door beneath the grating leading into Torres' room.

locations.title: Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Goodsprings](#loc=355160), Goodsprings Home - Underneath a wad of pre-war cash on a bookshelf next to the bed. May phase through the ground if you pick up any nearby items or knock it out of position. Must be stolen.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) safe in the corner of the bedroom.

locations.title: The King's Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [King's School of Impersonation](#loc=509980) - In the inventory of [The King](#loc=514365). Must be pickpocketed or taken from his corpse.

**Used to Unlock:** Back door of the room with the stage

locations.title: Control Tower Access Code
locations.description:
**Location:** [Camp McCarran Terminal Building](#loc=512639) - Carried by [Capt. Ronald Curtis](#loc=513436) and [Lt. Carrie Boyd](#loc=512647).

**Used to Unlock:** [Control Tower](#loc=512663)

locations.title: Slave Collar Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Hidden Valley Bunker](#loc=514343), L2 - In the inventory of [Elder McNamara](#loc=514349) while you're wearing a bomb collar during [Still in the Dark](#loc=502587).

**Used to Unlock:** Freedom!

locations.title: Comm Station Password
locations.description:
**Location:** N/A - Given to you by [Veronica](#loc=486438) as part of [I Could Make You Care](#loc=502651).

**Used to Unlock:** Terminal inside [Gibson's Shack](#loc=514378)

locations.title: Weathers Slave Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Cottonwood Cove](#loc=396377) - Purchased from [Canyon Runner](#loc=514380) for 300 / 150 caps. Can also be obtained through pickpocketing or taken from his corpse.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Hard) gate holding [Mrs. Weathers, Kenny & Sammy](#loc=514381) captive.

locations.title: Atomic Wrangler Room Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Atomic Wrangler](#loc=509982) - Given to you by [Francine Garret](#loc=513701) as a reward for completing [Debt Collector](#loc=502635).

**Used to Unlock:** Room in the corner of the casino's upper floor

locations.title: Bon Vivant Suite Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ultra-Luxe](#loc=509977) - Reward for winning around 11,250 chips in the Ultra-Luxe Casino.

**Used to Unlock:** Bon Vivant Suite

locations.title: Brotherhood of Steel Safehouse Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Hidden Valley Bunker](#loc=514343) - Reward for completing [Still in the Dark](#loc=502587)

**Used to Unlock:** [Brotherhood of Steel Safehouse](#loc=351601)

locations.title: Tabitha's Room Key (x2)
locations.description:
**Location:** Underneath the stairs outside of the Black Mountain Broadcast Building, in a fenced off area.

The second key is carried by [Tabitha](#loc=514650) herself.

**Used to Unlock:** Broadcast Building, 2nd Floor

locations.title: Tabitha's Equipment Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Black Mountain](#loc=484712), Broadcast Building 2nd Floor - In the inventory of Tabitha. She'll give it to you if you pass a Science 60 check on the broken Mr. Handy in the storage building.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked trunks in the area

locations.title: Black Mountain Prison Password
locations.description:
**Location:** [Black Mountain](#loc=484712), Prison - Obtained by reading Entry 6 on the unlocked terminal.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Very Hard) terminal next to the other door.

locations.title: Papa Khan's Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Great Khan Longhouse](#loc=514397) - In the inventory of [Papa Khan](#loc=514400)

**Used to Unlock:** The locked (Hard) door to Papa Khan's bedroom.

locations.title: Gomorrah Office Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Gomorrah](#loc=509971)- Carried by [Nero](#loc=512843) in the suites, and [Big Sal](#loc=514687) on the upper floor of the main level.

**Used to Unlock:** Offices on the upper floor of the main level

locations.title: Gomorrah Utility Room Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Gomorrah](#loc=509971) - Carried by [Troike](#loc=514685).

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Very Hard) door to the basement.

locations.title: White Glove Society Members Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ultra-Luxe](#loc=509977) - Carried by White Glove members throughout the main lobby.

**Used to Unlock:** White Glove Members Only Section

locations.title: Ultra-Luxe Freezer Key (x2)
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ultra-Luxe](#loc=509977) - Carried by [Mortimer](#loc=514697) on the casino floor, and [Philippe](#loc=514704) in the kitchen.

**Used to Unlock:** Freezer in the kitchen area.

locations.title: Ultra-Luxe Kitchen Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ultra-Luxe](#loc=509977), Casino Floor - Carried by [Mortimer](#loc=514697)

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Easy) door to the kitchen in The Gourmand restaurant.

locations.title: Ultra-Luxe Penthouse Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ultra-Luxe](#loc=509977), Casino Floor - Carried by [Mortimer](#loc=514697)

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Hard) elevator to the penthouse.

locations.title: Investigator's Room Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ultra-Luxe](#loc=509977), Casino - Given to you by [Mortimer](#loc=514697) if you ask to speak to the investigator during [Beyond the Beef](#loc=355873).

**Used to Unlock:** The first door on your right as you enter the hotel area.

locations.title: Forlorn Hope Cell Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Camp Forlorn Hope Jail](#loc=513294) - In the inventory of a trooper sitting at a table.

**Used to Unlock:** The jail's only cell.

locations.title: Freeside House Key (x2)
locations.description:
**Location:** Freeside - In the inventories of the guards standing outside the [Ruined Store](#loc=514372) during [G.I. Blues](#loc=502622).

**Used to Unlock:** [Ruined Store](#loc=514372)

locations.title: Door Override Card
locations.description:
**Location:** [Remnants Bunker](#loc=355870) - In the inventory of Orion Moreno if you do not pass a Speech 80 check after trying to convince the Remnants to side with the NCR during [For Auld Lang Syne](#loc=502616)

**Used to Unlock:** The room with the other Remnants

locations.title: Van Graff Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Silver Rush](#loc=509979) - In the inventories of [Gloria Van Graff](#loc=514719) and Jean-Baptiste Cutting.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Hard) door in the corner of the shop.

locations.title: Martina's Room Passcard
locations.description:
**Location:** [Vault 21 Gift Shop](#loc=509976), Hotel - In the inventory of [Martina Groesbeck](#loc=514730).

**Used to Unlock:** Martina's room in the Vault

locations.title: Weapons Footlocker Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Fort](#loc=355895) - In the inventory of the Legionary Main Gate Guard that takes your weapons when you enter.

**Used to Unlock:** Nearby weapons footlockers holding your items.

locations.title: Vegas Gate Key
locations.description:
**Location:** In the inventory of a [Securitron Gatekeeper](#loc=512687). 

Can also be found in the inventories of [Hadrian](#loc=513697), [Bruce Isaac](#loc=501914) and [The Lonesome Drifter](#loc=489336) after they're recruited as part of [Talent Pool](#loc=502639).

**Used to Unlock:** The Strip North Gate

locations.title: Luke's Find
locations.description:
**Location:** In the inventory of "Sweet" Jill, easiest to find by entering the East Central Sewers from [this entrance](#loc=514740), then entering the first room on your left.

**Used to Unlock:** Door to the Sealed Sewers

locations.title: NCR MP Confiscated Goods Trunk Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Camp McCarran Terminal Building](#loc=512639) - Reward for completing [The White Wash](#loc=502626)

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Very Hard) trunk holding skill magazines and other goodies in a nearby room.

locations.title: NCR Military Police HQ Storage Room Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [NCR Embassy](#loc=509974) - Carried by [Captain Marie Pappas](#loc=514748)

**Used to Unlock:** Storage room in the corner of [NCR Military Police HQ](#loc=509975)

locations.title: Hoover Dam Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Hoover Dam](#loc=396394) - Carried by [President Kimball](#loc=514885), his would-be assassin, and certain rangers during [Arizona Killer](#loc=491243).

**Used to Unlock:** ??

locations.title: Worn Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Central Sewers](#loc=514738) - In the inventory of a Glowing One, found in the area of the first screenshot.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Hard) Gun cabinet in East Central Sewers, in the area of the second screenshot.

locations.title: Luke's Find
locations.description:
**Location:** [Central Sewers](#loc=514738) - In the inventory of "Blind" Luke.

**Used to Unlock:** Door to the Sealed Sewers

locations.title: Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Central Sewers](#loc=514738) - On the ground next to a prospector at the north-eastern edge of the local map.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) radiation suit case in the room with the [Glowing One.](#loc=514887)

locations.title: Andy's Room Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Gray](#loc=509984) - In the inventories of thugs throughout the building, and Andy Scabb himself.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) door to Andy's Room

locations.title: Cerulean Robotics Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Cerulean Robotics](#loc=351669) - On the floor in the corner of the first room to your right when you enter - in the hand of a skeleton.

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) tool cabinet holding [Terminal Access Card](#loc=513690)

locations.title: Cachino's Room Key
locations.description:
**Location:** [Gomorrah](#loc=509971), Main Level - Given to you by the [Receptionist](#loc=512831) during [How Little We Know](#loc=502636) in exchange for 300 caps.

The price can be reduced to 200 caps with a Barter 55 check, or free with Strength 8.

**Used to Unlock:** Cachino's suite

locations.title: Big Sal's Password
locations.description:
**Location:** [Gomorrah](#loc=509971), Main Level - Upstairs, in the inventory of [Big Sal](#loc=514687).

**Used to Unlock:** Locked (Average) terminal in Big Sal's office.

locations.title: Powder Ganger Note
locations.description: [Powder Ganger Camp West](#loc=355754) - On a table near some dynamite.

locations.title: Mojave Express Delivery Order (4 of 6)
locations.description: In the inventory of Daniel Wyand, found dead outside the Nash Residence.

locations.title: Mayor Steyn's Journal 2/2
locations.description: [Nipton Road Reststop](#loc=355746) - On the counter between the wall and the cash register.

locations.title: Tomas's Journal
locations.description: In the inventory of [Tomas](#loc=486310). Must be pickpocketed or taken from his corpse.

locations.title: The Die-ary of Trash
locations.description:
[Old Nuclear Test Site](#loc=354643) - Three entries can be found inside the shack.
- On the shelves to your left as you enter.
- On the table next to a radio.
- In the inventory of Trash, found dead on the bed.

locations.title: Torn Diary Page 4
locations.description: [Matthews Animal Husbandry Farm](#loc=396382) - Next to a refrigerator in a burnt-down building.

locations.title: Torn Diary Page 3
locations.description: **Location:** [Matthews Animal Husbandry Farm](#loc=396382) - On the upper floor of a barn, on top of a wooden crate.

locations.title: Torn Diary Page 1
locations.description: **Location:** [Matthews Animal Husbandry Farm](#loc=396382) - On the stairs of a barn.

locations.title: Torn Diary Page 2
locations.description: **Location:** [Matthews Animal Husbandry Farm](#loc=396382) - Next to a suitcase on the back of the truck.

locations.title: First Sergeant Astor's Log
locations.description: On a picnic table near the tents.

locations.title: Legion Orders
locations.description:
[Camp Searchlight](#loc=396378), Searchlight Fire Station - In the inventories of two dead Legion recruits in the room where you fight the enormous radscorpion.

The key to the building can be found [here](#loc=486936).

locations.title: Ranger Holodisk Message
locations.description: **Location:** [Whittaker Farmstead](#loc=348668) - On a table inside the house's main room.

locations.title: Camp Guardian Log Page (x11)
locations.description:
**Location:** A series of 11 notes found throughout the [Camp Guardian](#loc=357325) area. Regardless of which one you pick up, their entries are unlocked in the same order.

- On the ground among some rocks, S / SE of the population sign. 
- A few steps SE of the previous note, sticking out of a bush near the fence gap.
- Stuck in a bush just past the second fence.
- Further up the path, on a wooden plank acting as stairs.
- At the top of the plank steps, sticking out of a bush.
- Quite a while later, sticking out of a bush on a ledge overlooking a lake.

locations.title: I Forgot to Remember to Forget
locations.description:
**Location:** [Novac](#loc=355741)

**Quest Giver:** [Boone](#loc=486459)

**Quest Progress Triggers:**

_Note: The quest will only progress while Boone is your companion when performing these actions._
- Killing [Vulpes Inculta](#loc=486319)
- Rescuing the Powder Gangers during [Booted](#loc=486343) 
- Killing all Legionaries at [Cottonwood Cove](#loc=396377) during [Eye for an Eye](#loc=502612)
- Killing Silus at [Camp McCarran](#loc=355038)
- Killing the Legion spy met during [I Put a Spell on You](#loc=502632)
- Killing or rescuing the hostages during [Back in Your Own Backyard](#loc=355720)
- Killing [Caesar](#loc=491239)

**Reward:**
- XP
- Boone begins wearing the 1st Recon Survival Armor or 1st Recon Assault Armor

locations.title: I Could Make You Care
locations.description:
**Location:** [188 Trading Post](#loc=355730)

**Quest Giver:** [Veronica](#loc=486438)

**Quest Progress Triggers:**

_Note: The quest will only progress while Veronica is your companion when having these conversations / performing these actions. You'll know the quest has progressed when she makes a unique comment._
- Speaking to [Tom Anderson](#loc=512766) at the [Casa Madrid Apartments](#loc=512757)
- Approaching [Vault 3](#loc=348699)
- Visiting any one of [Nelson](#loc=410492), [Cottonwood Cove](#loc=396377), or [The Fort](#loc=355895)
- Entering [Camp McCarran](#loc=355038)'s terminal building
- Telling the OSI researcher that you're Thomas Hildern in the terminal building
- Watching the full [Boomer museum tour](#loc=501680)
- Speaking to [Julie Farkas](#loc=354655) for the first time
- Speaking to [Jason Bright](#loc=501951) for the first time
- Speaking to Gloria Van Graff

**Reward:**
- XP


_If she stays loyal to the Brotherhood:_
- Veronica gains +4 DT

_If she leaves the Brotherhood:_
- Veronica attacks 30% faster when unarmed or using melee weapons

locations.title: ED-E My Love
locations.description:
**Location:** [Primm](#loc=355752), Nash Residence

**Quest Giver:** [ED-E](#loc=486178)

**Quest Progress Triggers:**

_Note: The quest will only progress while ED-E is your companion when having these conversations / performing these actions. You'll know the quest has progressed when it plays a recording, but 5 days must pass before a second one will play._
- **Recording 1:**
  - Speaking to [Old Lady Gibson](#loc=486639)
  - Speaking to [Lt. Haggerty](#loc=502520) / the guards outside of [HELIOS One](#loc=484709)
  - Speaking to [Ignacio Rivas](#loc=502552) about the Brotherhood and Archimedes
  - Speaking to [Doctor Henry](#loc=501651) about the Enclave, or [Calamity](#loc=501652) if he's not there
  - Speaking to [Knight Torres](#loc=514355)
  - Speaking to any Paladins
  - Speaking to [Thomas Hildern](#loc=512644) about his projects
  - Speaking to [Colonel Cassandra Moore](#loc=513378) about the Great Khans during [For the Republic, Part 2](#loc=496484)
  - Speaking to [Michael Angelo](#loc=513261) and attempting (or passing) the Medicine 55 check
  - Speaking to [Mr. House](#loc=512849) about the Brotherhood during [The House Always Wins V](#loc=502646)
  - Speaking to [Quartermaster Mayes](#loc=486963) about supply issues during [Restoring Hope](#loc=502628)

- **Recording 2:**
  - Speaking to [Michael Angelo](#loc=513261) about inspirations
  - Speaking to the Brotherhood after getting rid of [Dobson](#loc=514350) during [Still in the Dark](#loc=502587)
  - Speaking to the Scribe that approaches you after reaching Liked reputation with the Brotherhood
  - Speaking to [Veronica](#loc=486438) after her meeting with Elder McNamara or Hardin during [I Could Make You Care](#loc=502651)
  - Speaking to Veronica after she uses the terminal at [Gibson's Shack](#loc=514378)
  - Speaking to [Apprentice Watkins](#loc=514360) about the computers
  - Listening to a class held by a Scribe in the [Hidden Valley Bunker](#loc=514343)
  - Speaking to [Fantastic](#loc=502510) if you sent power to The Strip and Camp McCarran during [That Lucky Old Sun](#loc=502527)
- Speaking to [Thomas Hildern](#loc=512644) after [Angela Williams](#loc=512643) warns you about Vault 22 during [There Stands the Grass](#loc=502627)

**Reward:**
- XP


_If ED-E is upgraded by the Brotherhood:_
- ED-E gains +12 DT

_If ED-E is upgraded by the Followers of the Apocalypse:_
- ED-E gains a new weapon that deals extra damage

locations.title: Lily and Leo
locations.description:
**Location:** [Jacobstown](#loc=484626)

**Quest Giver:** [Lily](#loc=486675)

**Quest Progress Triggers:**
- Ask about Leo after Lily mentions him
- Asking what happened to her after a psychotic break during combat
- Asking about her medicine after she mentions taking it
- Listening to a recording that Lily plays after all of the above

**Reward:**

_If Lily takes full doses of her medicine:_
- Lily will no longer have psychotic breaks, but her damage is reduced

_If Lily continues taking half doses:_
- Lily's psychotic breaks will end whenever you crouch

_If Lily stops taking her medicine:_
- Psychotic breaks happen more often, and Lily does more damage

**Location:** [Camp Searchlight](#loc=396378), Searchlight Home. Held by [Private Edwards](#loc=486922).

- Speech 60 check

locations.title: Indiana Jones reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Suave Gambler Hat](#loc=485033)

Reference to a scene from Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull where Indiana Jones enters a fridge to protect himself from the heat, radiation and other effects of an atomic blast.

locations.title: Star Wars reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

Two skeletons can be found here; getting closer reveals their names are Owen and Beru. This is a reference to Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope, where Luke Skywalker's aunt and uncle (also named Beru and Owen) are found burnt to death in a similar pose.

locations.title: Far Out, Man
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

You'll find a small squad of aliens and their crashed ship here. One of them carries the unique [Alien Blaster](#loc=357399) weapon.

locations.title: The Princess Bride reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

In the [Broc Flower Cave](#loc=351678), [Vault 11](#loc=355579) and New Vegas Sewers, certain rat enemies will appear to be larger than usual and have their names changed to 'Rodent of Unusual Size'.

This is a reference to The Princess Bride, where a [Rodent of Unusual Size terrorizes Westley and Buttercup as they explore the Fire Swamp](https://youtu.be/Nv9CkjkOyzo?si=Jl-kii9R5XqMCcnd) - despite the former doubting that they exist. That line is also referenced when talking to [Lady Jane](#loc=513702).

locations.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

The [Holy Frag Grenades](#loc=357389) and instructions written on a box ("Pull pin and count to ~~5~~ 3") are a reference to one used in [Monty Python and the Holy Grail.](https://youtu.be/xOrgLj9lOwk?si=Rwnkl4RWjvwelF8v)

locations.title: Doctor Who reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only occurs with the Wild Wasteland trait.

While killing trespassers, the Securitrons here will say 'Exterminate! Exterminate!', referencing the [Daleks from Doctor Who](https://youtu.be/mxD-5z_xHBU?si=hXBEuOwBi_Ck-viu), a genocidal race of aliens that effectively use it as a catchphrase whenever they're, well, exterminating.

locations.title: Zybourne Clock reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

Replacing the regular corpse at the [Hilltop Stash](#loc=486171), Johnny is found dead among several props including four balls, five ace cards, and a pitcher.

These are references to Johnny Five-Aces, a character from Zybourne Clock. It was an ill-fated game idea accompanied by concept art presented to users on the Something Awful forums, where it was mocked and reached its ultimate fate as an inside joke.

locations.title: The One
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

An unexploded nuclear bomb can be looted here after passing a Science 60 check.

locations.title: Monty Python's Life of Brian reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

On the northern wall of Cottonwood Cove HQ, you'll find graffiti reading 'Romanes Eunt Domus', roughly translating to 'People called Romanes, they go, the house'.

This references graffiti that gets Brian into trouble for its incorrect grammar in [Monty Python's Life of Brian.](https://youtu.be/IIAdHEwiAy8?si=F2W6r7X9z-qSYadd)

locations.title: Lassie reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

With [Rex](#loc=486678) as a companion, he may alert you that Little Jimmy is in trouble and direct you to [Jimmy's Well](#loc=501715), where you'll find Jimmy's remains and the [Abilene Kid LE BB Gun](#loc=484716).

This sequence of events references Lassie, a TV show from the 1950s that starred a dog often responsible for saving its young owner by getting the attention of adults. A similar scenario also appeared in a quest in Fallout 2.

locations.title: Monty Python's Flying Circus reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

[Maud's Muggers](#loc=510052), a gang of vicious older women that attack as you leave [Cerulean Robotics](#loc=351669), are a reference to the [Hell's Grannies sketch](https://youtu.be/fvRgf5KK08U?si=1NVA21G4FZCmXgzm) from the 'Full Frontal Nudity' episode of the TV show Monty Python's Flying Circus.

locations.title: Where in the U.S.A. Is Carmen Sandiego reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only occurs with the Wild Wasteland trait.

As part of the [I Put a Spell on You](#loc=502632) quest, you can tell Captain Curtis that you've found out the mole is using the control tower. Entering it at night, you'll be ambushed - and Curtis will say 'You're getting too close, Shamus!' before attacking.

This is a reference to a line in the Apple II version of Where in the U.S.A. Is Carmen Sandiego?, used whenever you were [close to finding a suspect.](https://youtu.be/zTHiPiERQGE?si=5sxYSp-IwZLVpx85&t=261)

locations.title: CSI: Miami reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

During [Beyond the Beef](#loc=355873), the corpse of investigator Jay Barnes is replaced by one named Crusoe with a suit, red hair, and sunglasses - a reference to David Caruso's character Horatio Caine from the TV series CSI: Miami.

locations.title: Aliens reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only occurs with the Wild Wasteland trait.

Tuning into the NCR Emergency Radio broadcast during the final mission, troopers will occasionally reference lines from Aliens (1986) - namely ['Game over, man! Game over!'](https://youtu.be/oBB3C59Dzt0?si=iLBvTraJjBg_Tmiv) and ['They're coming out of the walls! They're coming out of the goddamn walls!'](https://youtu.be/DJQ_7jKIm24?si=1R7OQikWSbPuLzf4)

locations.title: Robocop reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only occurs with the Wild Wasteland trait.

If you get Heck Gunderson arrested during [Beyond the Beef](#loc=355873), the Securitron taking him in will reference a line from Robocop (1987) - ['dead or alive, you're coming with me'.](https://youtu.be/gtJlseQAlkw?si=A6Z27AFoZp6BqhKd)

locations.title: Donny and Marie reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only occurs with the Wild Wasteland trait

When threatening Motor-Runner in [Vault 3](#loc=348699), he'll refer to his dogs as Donny and Marie - a straightforward reference to a 1976 TV series of the same name.

locations.title: Star Trek reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only occurs with the Wild Wasteland trait

Speaking to [Ambassador Dennis Crocker](#loc=489542) about Pacer's Jet problem during [Kings' Gambit](#loc=501714) prompts him to say ''Damn it, I'm an ambassador, not a doctor. You'll have to find some other way."

In the original Star Trek TV series, Leonard McCoy would often object to various situations with similar phrases - always beginning with ["I'm a doctor, not a..."](https://youtu.be/z_meh52E-bo?si=B6VgRXKNpoMRvD26)

locations.title: Sierra Madre / Dead Money references
locations.description:
Inside the [East Pump Station](#loc=356055), you'll find posters and postcards depicting Vera Keyes, the Sierra Madre and Dean Domino from the Dead Money DLC. 

They were in the game even before the DLC was released - a cheeky bit of foreshadowing!

locations.title: Pimp-Boy 3 Billion
locations.description:
Special skin for the Pip-Boy, given by [Mick](#loc=354635) after asking about his deal with the Omertas before progressing in [How Little We Know](#loc=502636).

If you take Cachino's side, the Pimp-Boy can **only** be obtained by getting Troike out of his contract. You can do this by speaking to Big Sal and passing a Barter 45 check, or Speech 53 check, or handing over 300 Caps.

If you take Nero and Big Sal's side, complete the quest fully then speak to Big Sal and pass a Speech 50 check. 

After either of the above, tell Mick the good news, and you'll become the coolest courier in the Mojave.
